test_title: PYST 25: SSC MTS - Reasoning (Held on: 14 July 2022 Shift 3)
subject: reasoning
question:
Select the figure among from the given options that can replace the question mark (?) in the following series.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/78483b20089108de5baeaeee062660a30695e41bf86551f591ab304b8b997a81.png]
solution:
The logic followed here is:

For every **next box**, there is an **addition of two more squares**.

First box = 4 squares,

Second box = 6 squares,

Third box = 8 squares,

Fourth box = 10 squares,

So, the fifth box will have 12 squares.

Only option (3) has a box having 12 squares.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/50a9c40b509e5688dde6f693e50a15530fc8c828af952c818ce5cddc679de7ad.png] 

Therefore, '?' will be replaced by the image of option (3).

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option(3)".**
